facts: Lumia imaging apps are imaging applications by Microsoft Mobile and formerly by Nokia.
Lumia imaging apps are for Lumia devices.
Lumia imaging apps are built on the technology of Scalado.
Lumia Panorama was developed earlier by Nokia.
Lumia Panorama was originally for Symbian devices.
Lumia Panorama was originally for MeeGo devices.
The Lumia imaging applications were notably all branded with "Nokia" in front of their names.
After Microsoft acquired Nokia's devices and services business, the Nokia branding was superseded with "Lumia".
Updates often included nothing but name changes.
For the Lumia Camera, updates included a new wide range of feature additions.
Most of the imaging applications are developed by the Microsoft Lund division.
Some Lumia imaging applications stopped working in October 2015.
Lumia imaging features were integrated into the Windows Camera.
Lumia imaging features were integrated into Microsoft Photos applications.
Microsoft acquired Nokia's devices and services business.
